title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 23:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 23:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp = 1.33 (label 1P) at 23:00 UTC. The 23:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 23:59; end-of-hour 1.33/1P). 00:00 UTC on 22 September is a trailing incomplete hour (28 samples to 00:27), so it is not used. Last-180 maximum 1.33 first at 22:54 UTC on 21 September (label 1P; last-180 window from 21:28 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.33 (22:54 UTC, label 1P). Window start 18:30 UTC on 21 September (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新可靠整點估計 Kp = 1.33（標籤 1P；23:00 UTC）。23:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 23:59，時段末 1.33／1P）。2026-09-22 00:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 00:27 共 28 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 1.33（最先見於 2026-09-21 22:54 UTC；標籤 1P；近 180 筆窗自 21:28 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.33（22:54 UTC；標籤 1P）。窗起點 2026-09-21 18:30 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (23:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 23:00 UTC is 1.33/1P; the trailing 00:00 hour on 22 September is incomplete (28 samples to 00:27) and unused.

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.2, depth about 10 km. Current day-feed maximum is mb 5.5 (us7000tiur, 35 km NNE of Ruteng, Indonesia).

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
